name: Sourcey
tagline: Research agent-ready services with evidence and current offer details
description: Use Sourcey to search and compare service offers, inspect supporting evidence and changes, check readiness, and find the service details needed before an integration. Its hosted MCP exposes eight read-only research and preparation tools; no purchase is made by installing it.

install.notes: Use the hosted endpoint for current Sourcey data. The linked repository also documents the optional npm bridge and documentation workflow.
